title: Air-fryer salt and pepper wings
subtitle: Crispy wings seasoned simply with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
excerpt: Chicken wings cooked in the air fryer until the skin blisters and crisps, seasoned with salt, black pepper, and garlic. No sauce, no batter ,  just properly crisp skin. Serves two as a main or four as a snack.
sourceNotes: Salt and pepper wings are a simple preparation common across Chinese-American takeaway cooking and British pub menus. The air fryer produces a drier heat than deep-frying, which crisps the skin without the need for batter or oil.

content.text: Salt and pepper wings are about the skin, not the sauce. Pat the wings completely dry before seasoning ,  moisture is the enemy of a crisp finish. The air fryer at 200°C gives the same blistered, crackly skin you get from deep-frying, with far less oil.

items.prepNote: wing tips removed, drumette and flat separated if large, patted dry

content.text: Pat {{chicken-wings}} of wings completely dry with paper towels. Toss with {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt and {{garlic-powder}} of garlic powder. Spray lightly with cooking oil. Preheat the air fryer to 200°C for 3 minutes. Cook the wings in a single layer for 12 minutes, flip, then cook for a further 10-13 minutes until the skin is blistered and golden. Grind fresh black pepper generously over the wings straight out of the fryer.

items.cause: Wings not dried properly, or too many in the basket at once.
items.fix: Pat wings dry aggressively. Cook in a single layer with space between pieces. Overlap kills the crisp finish.
Check at 22 minutes. The wing meat is thin and cooks quickly; pull as soon as the skin blisters and the meat is cooked through.
Salt and pepper wings need a generous hand. Apply the seasoning at least 15 minutes before cooking so it penetrates the surface.

content.text: Salt and pepper wings are a pub and takeaway staple. At home they make a low-effort snack that takes about half an hour from fridge to plate. Serve with a good hot sauce on the side or a simple dip of soured cream and chives.
